method: For each adjacent-time state transition A->B (source==model buckets, n>=30), attribute win-prob impact as mean_y(B) - mean_y(A) where mean_y is the state's calibrated realized win rate.
assumptions: mean_y (realized win rate per bucket) is the state's calibrated win prob.
Transitions restricted to consecutive time buckets; no skipping.
Not observed transition frequencies -- the win-prob DIFFERENCE between two states.
Buckets thinner than n=30 are dropped (noisy mean_y).
